title: Child marriage before 18, LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World, by location
headline: Data on child marriage cover 44 of 44 LDCs, 31 of 32 LLDCs and 27 of 39 SIDS
subtitle: Percentage of women (aged 20-24 years) married or in union before age 18
years: Countries with any value; for 44 of the 79 with data, the latest is from 2020 or earlier.
data_line: Data: UNICEF via UN SDG Global Database, series SP_DYN_MRBF18, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Data on child marriage cover 44 of 44 LDCs, 31 of 32 LLDCs and 27 of 39 SIDS. Countries with any value; for 44 of the 79 with data, the latest is from 2020 or earlier. LDCs: 44 of 44 countries with data; LLDCs: 31 of 32 countries with data; SIDS: 27 of 39 countries with data
method: Method: latest value per country; 2020 or earlier is not recent.
question: Which countries have found a way to measure child marriage more often, and what made it possible?
